ticker.label: Ticker
ticker.text: The short symbol that identifies a stock on the exchange (e.g. AAPL = Apple).

sector.label: Sector
sector.text: GICS sector the company belongs to (e.g. Information Technology, Health Care).

price.label: Price
price.text: Latest available closing price, in US dollars, adjusted for splits and dividends.

perf_1m.label: Perf 1M %
perf_1m.text: Percentage change in price over the last ~21 trading days (about 1 month).

perf_3m.label: Perf 3M %
perf_3m.text: Percentage change in price over the last ~63 trading days (about 3 months).

perf_6m.label: Perf 6M %
perf_6m.text: Percentage change in price over the last ~126 trading days (about 6 months).

perf_12m.label: Perf 12M %
perf_12m.text: Percentage change in price over the last ~252 trading days (about 12 months).

rs_vs_spy.label: RS vs SPY 6M %
rs_vs_spy.text: The stock's 6-month performance compared with the benchmark SPY (an ETF that tracks the S&P 500). Positive = the stock beat the index over the period, negative = it lagged. Formula: (1 + stock return) / (1 + SPY return) - 1.

dist_high.label: Dist. 52w High %
dist_high.text: Percentage distance of the current price from the 52-week high. Always 0 or negative: 0 means the stock is at its yearly high, -20 means it is 20% below it.

dist_low.label: Dist. 52w Low %
dist_low.text: Percentage distance of the current price from the 52-week low. Always 0 or positive: the higher it is, the further the stock has moved away from its yearly low.

vs_sma50.label: vs SMA50 %
vs_sma50.text: Percentage distance between the price and its 50-day simple moving average (the average of the last 50 closes). Positive = price above the average, negative = below.

vs_sma200.label: vs SMA200 %
vs_sma200.text: Percentage distance between the price and its 200-day simple moving average. Positive = price above the average, negative = below. The SMA200 is a long-term average.

avg_vol.label: Avg Vol 50d
avg_vol.text: Average number of shares traded per day over the last 50 trading days. It shows how actively the stock is traded (liquidity).

rel_vol.label: Rel. Volume
rel_vol.text: Volume of the latest session divided by the 50-day average volume. 1 = normal volume, 2 = twice the usual, 0.5 = half.

atr_pct.label: ATR %
atr_pct.text: 14-day Average True Range as a percentage of the price: it measures the average size of the daily move, i.e. volatility. The higher it is, the more the price moves in a day.

rs_composite.label: RS Composite
rs_composite.text: A score from 1 to 99 showing how the stock's performance ranks against all the other stocks in the list. 99 = in the top 1% of the list, 50 = average, 1 = among the weakest. It is based on a weighted average of 3, 6, 9 and 12-month performance (the most recent quarter weighs 40%). It describes the past; it is not a forecast.

pe_ttm.label: P/E TTM
pe_ttm.text: Ratio between the price and earnings per share over the last 12 months (TTM = trailing twelve months). It shows how many dollars you pay for each dollar of yearly earnings. Not shown if the company is making a loss.

mom_breve.label: Short Mom
mom_breve.text: Short-term momentum, from 1 to 99: the stock's rank in the list based on 1-week (50% weight), 2-week (30%) and 1-month (20%) performance. 99 = among the strongest in the short term, 1 = among the weakest. It describes the recent past; it is not a forecast.

state.label: State
state.text: A descriptive label based on Δ 1W-3W: 'Improving' if Δ is ≥ +10, 'Weakening' if ≤ -10, 'Steady' otherwise. It shows whether recent relative strength (1 week) has risen or fallen compared with 3 weeks ago.

delta_1w3w.label: Δ 1W-3W
delta_1w3w.text: Difference between the rank (1-99) of the 1-week performance and that of the 3-week performance. Positive = the stock accelerated in the last week compared with the last 3 weeks, negative = it slowed down. Theoretical range from -98 to +98.

avwap.label: AVWAP
avwap.text: Number (0 to 4) of AVWAPs the price is above. AVWAP is the volume-weighted average price calculated from an anchor date. The 4 anchors are: start of the month (M), start of the quarter (Q), last 6 months (6M) and start of the year (Y). 4/4 = price above all of them, 0/4 = below all of them.

avwap_m.label: AVWAP M
avwap_m.text: % distance of the price from the AVWAP (volume-weighted average price) anchored at the start of the month. Positive = price above the AVWAP.

avwap_q.label: AVWAP Q
avwap_q.text: % distance of the price from the AVWAP (volume-weighted average price) anchored at the start of the quarter. Positive = price above the AVWAP.

avwap_6m.label: AVWAP 6M
avwap_6m.text: % distance of the price from the AVWAP (volume-weighted average price) anchored 6 months ago. Positive = price above the AVWAP.

avwap_y.label: AVWAP Y
avwap_y.text: % distance of the price from the AVWAP (volume-weighted average price) anchored at the start of the year. Positive = price above the AVWAP.

eps_yoy.label: EPS YoY
eps_yoy.text: % change in earnings per share of the latest quarter versus the same quarter a year earlier (YoY = year over year). 'Loss' = negative earnings per share over the last 12 months. Source: Yahoo Finance.

sales_yoy.label: Sales YoY
sales_yoy.text: % change in revenue of the latest quarter versus the same quarter a year earlier. Source: Yahoo Finance.

etf.label: ETF
etf.text: SPDR sector ETF that represents the company's GICS sector (e.g. XLK = technology, XLV = health care, XLF = financials).

last_date.label: Last update
last_date.text: Date of the latest trading session included in the data for this stock (end-of-day close). The time next to it is when the scanner data was last refreshed (Rome time).
